optionCandidates.reason: Candidate clears every repository seed-lane gate: user-authorized SHADOW_ONLY cash bootstrap, DTE bucket, underlying type, position limit and weekly cap. There is no fixed repository premium cap; live Robinhood quote freshness, <=10% spread, real volume/open interest, tradability, whole-contract cash/unleveraged buying power, duplicate-order and session checks remain mandatory immediately before submission.

optionsLane.rule: Options are cash-funded long calls/puts only. Earned admission remains preferred, but the explicit user-authorized live-cash bootstrap may publish SHADOW_ONLY candidates while LIVE_SUSPENDED stays blocked. Robinhood option-position/order state, <=10% spread, real volume/open interest, tradability, whole-contract cash/unleveraged buying power, duplicate state and same-day exit remain mandatory; no exercise/overnight.

liveBootstrap.rule: User-authorized XND/DJX live bootstrap. Permit real-money long calls/puts only after fresh Teststock proxy direction plus exact live Robinhood contract resolution. There is no fixed repository premium cap: the whole contract plus known fees must fit fresh available cash/unleveraged buying power in the dedicated account. One new index-option position per New York trading day, one concurrent position, same-session exit, no margin, no exercise.

indexOptionsLane.rule: XND/DJX use QQQ/DIA for direction only. LIVE_MICRO_BOOTSTRAP and later evidence-earned live states may publish one broker-resolution request with no fixed repository premium cap; Robinhood fresh cash/unleveraged buying power is the hard affordability ceiling, and exact contract, bid/ask, liquidity, affordability, duplicate-state and session checks remain mandatory.

crossAssetPreference.rule: After exits, compare independently qualified option and stock opportunities by executable after-cost evidence. Stock/ETF options and XND/DJX index options use separate admission ledgers; neither may borrow the other's evidence. A qualified option may be presented ahead of stock entries only after its own admission, live chain/liquidity, whole-contract cash/risk, concurrency, duplicate and session gates pass. Never force an option to satisfy a frequency target.

multiStockPolicy.rule: Expose every already-qualified current-generation stock candidate in rank order. ChatGPT may execute as many as remain independently qualified after immediate broker rechecks and dynamic cash, portfolio-heat, correlation, account-floor and aggregate-stop-risk limits. Never force a trade.

noActionInstruction: If chatgptShouldRun is false, stop immediately. Do not call Robinhood, research markets, or produce a long report.
actionInstruction: For every current trigger, including optionCandidates and indexOptionResolutionRequests when present, reconcile Robinhood positions, open orders and recent order history before submission. INDEX_OPTION_RESOLUTION_REQUEST is not an exact contract order: resolve the live Robinhood XND/DJX chain first, choose only a long call/put matching the encoded direction and DTE bounds, and require the total one-contract premium plus known fees to fit fresh Robinhood cash/unleveraged buying power (and any non-null encoded maxOrderUsd if present); skip if spread/liquidity/cash/duplicate/session/profitability guards fail. Exit events always take priority and block every new buy for the run. Stock entries require authoritative regular-session status and at least 20 minutes to close both here and again at the broker-time recheck. For BUY_TRIGGER dispatches, process automaticStockCandidates in rank order without requesting user approval. Recheck each candidate independently immediately before submission; after every confirmed fill recompute cash, account floor, deployed capital, planned stop risk, correlation, portfolio heat, protection capability and broker/account restrictions. Skip any candidate that no longer qualifies. Seed-lane candidates remain automatic only within their encoded caps and protection requirements. A previously published fingerprint is not proof of execution. Reconcile ambiguous or partial results by original/client order ID and never blindly retry an uncertain submission.

consumerContract.fallbackRule: Process all already-qualified stock candidates in order. Failed candidates fall through. Confirmed fills dynamically reduce remaining capacity before the next candidate.
consumerContract.duplicateRule: Before every order, reconcile current Robinhood positions, open orders and recent order history. One logical trigger may create at most one live broker entry; ambiguous submissions must be reconciled before any replacement.
consumerContract.retryRule: After an ambiguous response, reconcile by original/client order ID and broker state. Never create a replacement order until the original is conclusively cancelled or rejected.
consumerContract.creditRule: Use one ChatGPT run for the ordered candidate sequence where practical. The runner usage gate limits repeated invocations; broker reconciliation prevents duplicate orders when a still-current trigger is redispatched.

stockApprovalNotification.instruction: Stock approval notifications are disabled because qualified stock entries are automatic.

stopPriorityRule: A stop event outranks profit targets and buys. When any exit event exists, do not evaluate or submit a new buy.

wakeBridge.note: GitHub/Teststock generates intelligence packets only. The authorized ChatGPT execution layer independently verifies live Robinhood state and performs permitted broker actions through Robinhood tools; Teststock never submits orders.
